title: Free Night Awards Training Note: Several Awards and Mixed Payment on One Reservation
content:
How Free Night Awards may sit together on one reservation, and alongside nights paid otherwise, is fixed by six terms. They are identical for the 25K, 35K, 40K, 50K and 85K Free Night Awards and the Any Hotel Free Night Award.

| Term | Value for every award type |
|---|---|
| Most awards that may be applied to one reservation | 5 |
| A night can be paid by only one award | Yes |
| Awards are always applied to the earliest nights of the reservation | Yes |
| The award may sit on a reservation whose other nights are paid with points | Yes |
| The award may sit on a reservation with nights paid in cash | No |
| Several awards may be used on one reservation | Yes |

## Questions answered

**How many awards can one reservation carry?**
At most 5, whatever the award types.

**Can two awards share one night?**
No. Each night is paid by one award only.

**Which nights do the awards pay?**
The earliest nights of the reservation. Awards are always applied to the earliest nights.

**May the other nights be paid with points?**
Yes. An award may sit on a reservation whose other nights are paid with points.

**May the other nights be paid in cash?**
No. An award may not sit on a reservation with nights paid in cash.

**May a 35K Free Night Award and a 50K Free Night Award be used on one reservation?**
Yes. Several awards may be used on one reservation, and that includes awards of different types.

## Hypothetical reservation

A hypothetical seven-night reservation with three awards: the awards pay nights one, two and three, one award each; nights four to seven may be paid with points, and none of the seven nights may be paid in cash.
